Copied.description: One file a snapshot copied: its path in the snapshot's folder, and the digest of its bytes.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of its bytes, as they were copied.

path.description:
Its path in the snapshot's folder: `song.duet`, or `parts/<file>`. The working file it
was copied from is at the same path in the song's folder.

Date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-11-17.

FileDigest.description: The SHA-256 of a file's bytes: sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits.

Name.description: A name in the project: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, such as wayfaring or blood-sport-v2.

RelPath.description: A path relative to the project's root, with `/` between its parts and no empty, `.` or `..` part.

Snapshot.description: What a snapshot is: the body of `snapshot` 1.0.

date.description: The day it was taken, in UTC.

files.description:
Every file copied into the snapshot's folder, `song.duet` first, then each part the
composition placed, as `parts/<file>`, each with the digest of its bytes.

name.description: The snapshot's name, as the owner gave it. Its folder is `<date>-<name>`.

said.description: What the owner said of it, in their words. duet never reads it.

takes.description: The takes the song linked when the snapshot was taken, each by its name and digest.

TakeDigest.description: The SHA-256 of a take's decoded samples: the bytes `duet-take-1`, the rate as a little-endian u32, the channel count as a little-endian u16, then every sample, interleaved, as the little-endian bits of its f32.

TakeRef.description: A take as the index names it: its name and its digest, never a path.

description: A .duet document of kind snapshot, at schema version 1.0.
title: duet snapshot 1.0
